hypothesis: At a maximum-hold timer exit, retaining the recorded venue stop and extending exactly five completed one-minute bars may improve exit capture when the signal provider's causal 15-minute context remains aligned with the position and the complete lifecycle opposition journal contains zero opposed decisions. This is a post-hoc hypothesis formed from one v14 SOL short and must be evaluated prospectively without altering live execution.
decision: Keep the authorized v14 runtime, entries, sizing, exact 5-minute breakout requirement, venue protection, maximum-hold controller, and execution scope unchanged. Continue the revision-13 SOL support-decay observer because no post-cutoff qualifying lifecycle exists yet. Reject relaxing the 5m_not_breakout entry requirement because the frozen HYPE and SOL forward challengers remain negative after estimated friction. Freeze aligned_zero_opposition_timer_extension_observer_v1 at a five-minute horizon from the new prospective cutoff. It may record causal eligibility, retained-stop touches, completed-candle excursions, and incremental gross price-path PnL, but it cannot retain, close, resize, rank, gate, route, promote, or submit a live position.
falsifier: The five-minute extension hypothesis is weakened by any prospective qualifying v14 lifecycle whose retained stop is touched, whose incremental gross path is negative, or whose later fees, funding, slippage, or gap-through erase the apparent improvement. It is provisionally strengthened only if independent later qualifying lifecycles include both long and short sides and retain positive median incremental after-cost return without one observation dominating. Any changed horizon, alignment definition, opposition threshold, persistence rule, stop treatment, cost model, or eligibility scope is a new trial and cannot be pooled with this frozen observer.
limitations: The v14 SOL observation was inspected before this observer was frozen and is hypothesis-formation evidence rather than prospective validation.
Current-profile evidence is one SOL short; it cannot establish repeatability, long-side behavior, cross-asset transfer, or stability across regimes.
All-live evidence contains only two eligible exits from mixed historical profiles: one positive SOL short and one negative HYPE long.
The all-live combined incremental gross PnL is positive but too small and sparse to establish an after-cost edge.
The five-minute projection is based on completed candle extrema and close; it cannot prove intrabar ordering, queue position, latency, or the executable fill after a gap.
Incremental PnL is gross of later funding, fee-rate changes, and exit slippage even though the original recorded venue stop is retained.
The HYPE and SOL entry-relaxation challengers are simulated BBO paths and do not prove private IOC fills, but both contradict removing the 5-minute breakout requirement in their current samples.
No live strategy, position, order, stop, target, sizing policy, backend process, checkpoint process, or portfolio configuration changed as a result of this revision.
